bounded_scope: Every one of the 114 complete extracted spell bodies at levels 3-5; no 2014 rule substitution, no production writes or executable recipes
source_method: Direct full-body reading in nine contiguous source-order slices, followed by independent per-entry paraphrase; inventory used only as qualified comparison. Primary-lines 9210-9213 and 9255-9273 directly inspected for displacement.
common_requirements: Every cast preserves its current-source casting time, range, component/hand/focus/cost profile, duration, selected slot, scaling, target contracts and common casting rules; stored/header metadata are source facts, not admitted machine contracts.
Hidden type/eligibility invalidity follows exact paid no-effect and disclosure semantics. Unknown input, unsupported package and hidden invalid target are distinct outcomes.

Every repeated/delayed occurrence has exact native owner, bound chronology/procedure occurrence, dependency enrollment, fixed RNG and replay/recovery identity. Source duration is not automatically a concentration or ongoing range leash.

Every supporting condition, form, stat block/action, species, component Asset, damage/health/casting policy and sense/travel exception must be admitted transitively. Corpus names or grouped tags do not establish support.

Rows route architectural obligations only. They do not supply complete numeric recipes, executable operation IDs, admitted schemas/selectors/accessors/facts, golden tests, production success or measured latency.

owner_read_manifest.role: Bounded declarative composition, immutable facts, continuation/cache boundary
Stable Actor identity, native HP/LifeState, derived conditions and voluntary-PC agency
Native health/effect/support/temporal authority; current generic concentration is conformance-only
Existing world.zone envelope; untyped geometry/status do not prove exact spell consumers
Targeted native occurrence/dependency enrollment and no-campaign-scan/time-invention clauses

candidate_omissions_or_needed_explicit_p.qualification: Table reroll-on-one has no finite worst-case roll count. Admit narrow typed stochastic repeat/continuation preserving original RNG/distribution and retry evidence; no capped redraw, changed die or unrestricted loop.

Post-ending lethargy/fade, triggered stored concentration-free child and permanent stone survive original source ending under exact successor/ownership transfer. Immutable support-parent closure cannot be defeated by arbitrary detach.
Mutates another spell duration when binding summoned/created creature; must reconcile original concentration and source support precisely. Text does not universally waive concentration.
Retains native HP and gives Beast-based temporary HP. Resolve replacement/nonstacking, provenance, zero-tempHP early ending and conditional remaining-tempHP cleanup; no replacement-HP snapshot.
Cure interception, prezero/instant-kill prevention, max-HP prevention and special failed-cast/material-origin gates are exact timing/cost policies rather than generic damage/condition handlers.

True-memory restoration, death-time knowledge, hidden save purpose, recipient blocks and scoped observation need exact native knowledge/source lifecycle; physical shared context never grants logical access.

Enclosure save permits spending target reaction to escape; commanded reactions consume caster reaction and require precise target entitlement; counter costs retain casting action while preserving slot.

Caster/target/day/rest/year counters and same-location repeat-cast permanence require typed native episode/progress profiles and indexed resets/due work, not scans of historical casts or Effect details.
Source reconstruction must correct displaced blocks/continuations, exclude foreign tails, preserve Unicode-minus signed values and verify the truncated licensed continuation before recipe admission.
Complete statblock/actions/species traits and discretion-choice dependency closure is required. Example statblocks or decorative action text do not exhaust legal form/summon/species domains.
